reading.workResult: Completed Skill 03 source-complete Deep Reading for all three same-date selected objects after ordered Runtime authority and Worker Claimed were durably established. Q-20260820-01 verified that Codex removed Git from the known-safe command shortcut on Unix and Windows because repository configuration can redirect nominally read-only Git operations into helper execution; under UnlessTrusted, plain git status now requires approval unless an explicit execution-policy rule allows it, while OnRequest retains its own policy semantics and absolute-path tests distinguish declared host executables from unmatched Git paths. This establishes an effective-execution approval boundary, not a claim that every Git invocation is dangerous or that approval alone contains all side effects. Q-20260820-02 verified that Google ADK now scrubs credential-bearing request function calls from RemoteA2aAgent session-history reconstruction before other-agent rendering can inline their arguments; detection uses the known adk_request_credential name plus nested AuthConfig shape, preserves ordinary top-level auth_scheme calls, non-secret text siblings, the mock-auth prompt and the original local history, and keeps existing response-side credential filtering. This is a demonstrated remote-history projection boundary, not general A2A confidentiality or local secret-at-rest protection. Q-20260820-03 verified that ADK FileArtifactService now reserves hidden .{version}.pending directories, stages payload and metadata there, publishes only through one os.replace to the integer version name, cleans failed staging, avoids concurrent/stale-version collisions, intentionally permits version gaps from abandoned reservations, and explicitly does not provide fsync-backed power-loss durability. This is process-level atomic publication under the demonstrated filesystem model, not distributed transactionality or crash-consistent storage durability. Three durable Reading Notes were produced. No Research Analysis, article drafting, visualization or publication was performed.
reading.workResult_zh: 仅在有序 Runtime 执行权与 Worker Claimed 均完成持久核验后，才对三个同日已选对象完成 Skill 03 Source-complete Deep Reading。Q-20260820-01 核验了 Codex 因仓库配置可能把名义只读 Git 操作重定向为 helper 执行，而在 Unix 与 Windows 路径上取消 Git 的 Known-safe 快捷分类；在 UnlessTrusted 下，普通 git status 现在需要审批，除非显式 Execution Policy Rule 允许；OnRequest 仍保留自己的策略语义，Absolute-path 测试也区分已声明 Host Executable 与未匹配的 Git 路径。该结论证明的是 Effective Execution 的审批边界，不是“所有 Git 调用都危险”，也不是“审批本身即可约束全部外部副作用”。Q-20260820-02 核验了 Google ADK 现在会在 RemoteA2aAgent 从 Session History 重建远端消息时，先于 Other-agent Rendering 清除携带凭据的 Request Function Call，避免参数被内联为文本后再处理；检测同时使用已知 adk_request_credential 名称与嵌套 AuthConfig Shape，并保留普通顶层 auth_scheme 调用、非秘密 Text Sibling、Mock-auth Prompt 与原始本地 History，同时继续保留既有 Response-side Credential Filtering。该机制证明的是远端 History Projection 的凭据清除边界，不是一般性的 A2A 机密性或本地 Secret-at-rest 保护。Q-20260820-03 核验了 ADK FileArtifactService 现在通过隐藏 .{version}.pending 目录预留版本，在其中写入 Payload 与 Metadata，最后仅通过一次 os.replace 把完整目录发布为整数版本；失败 Staging 会清理，并发写入与 Stale Version List 不再覆盖既有版本；Abandoned Reservation 会故意留下版本缺口，且实现明确没有 fsync 支持的断电持久性保证。该结论证明的是所示文件系统模型下的 Process-level Atomic Publication，不是分布式事务或 Crash-consistent Storage Durability。共形成 3 份持久 Reading Note。未执行 Research Analysis、文章写作、可视化或发布。

researchObjects.judgment: For digital employees, an action name should be treated as intent evidence rather than execution authority. When configuration, wrappers or environment can change what actually runs, admission should bind the decision to an effective-execution identity that includes executable/context and governing policy; approval authorizes that bounded decision but does not prove downstream effect containment.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: 对数字员工而言，Action Name 应被视为 Intent Evidence，而不是 Execution Authority。当 Configuration、Wrapper 或 Environment 能改变实际执行内容时，Admission 应把决策绑定到包含 Executable/Context 与 Governing Policy 的 Effective-execution Identity；Approval 只授权这一有界决策，并不证明后续 Effect 已被约束。

researchObjects.judgment: Cross-agent history should be modeled as a policy-enforcing projection rather than transparent replay: a runtime may retain richer local evidence while deriving destination-specific context that removes unauthorized control-plane material before transformations erase semantic structure. This reduces the demonstrated credential-forwarding risk but does not establish general A2A confidentiality or peer trust.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Cross-agent History 应被建模为 Policy-enforcing Projection，而不是 Transparent Replay：Runtime 可以保留更丰富的 Local Evidence，同时派生 Destination-specific Context，在转换抹去 Semantic Structure 之前移除未获授权的 Control-plane Material。该模式降低已演示 Credential-forwarding Risk，但不建立一般 A2A Confidentiality 或 Peer Trust。

researchObjects.judgment: Artifact publication should separate ownership, completeness, visibility and durability. A complete staged representation may cross an atomic reader-visibility boundary through rename under the demonstrated filesystem assumptions, but that visibility event is not a crash-durability certificate; durability and abandoned-state recovery require independent evidence and governance.
researchObjects.judgment_zh: Artifact Publication 应分离 Ownership、Completeness、Visibility 与 Durability。完整 Staged Representation 可以在已演示 Filesystem Assumption 下通过 Rename 跨越 Atomic Reader-visibility Boundary，但该 Visibility Event 不是 Crash-durability Certificate；Durability 与 Abandoned-state Recovery 需要独立 Evidence 与 Governance。
